name: t15
why: One factor against t11 (the best scored): amplitude 0.394 = 2 x 0.197; sources, weights, cache r4, gamma and generator unchanged. 0.197 was calibrated to minimise pseudobulk MSE (CP-0003/0004, D-006), but the official mse member is clipped at 0 in all seven scored submissions, while pds_cosine, the member that carries the score, rose from t02 to t03 (amplitude x1 -> x2, but t03 also took its cis bins from a pairs table), 0.609 -> 0.649: a hint, not a measurement of the amplitude alone.
